name: xneelo Helper
author: xneelo

sections.description:
Xneelo Helper Plugin:
* Allows for your site to automatically clear the xneelo Cache, whenever a post is updated.
* Allows you to clear the cache for a single page, or your entire site, from within the admin bar.
* Enables compatibility of WP rocket with xneelo Cache.

Requirements

  • Pretty Permalinks enabled
  • Xneelo Cache
sections.installation:
Automatic Install

  1. Download the zip file.
  2. Either upload the zip file to the add plugins page in WP Admin

Manual Install

  1. Download the zip file.
  2. Extract the zip folder into the wp-contents/plugins
sections.faq:
Must I be hosted with xneelo to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin provides the ability to purge xneelo Cache, which is only available when your site is hosted with xneelo

What is xneelo Cache

You can find more helpful information on xneelo Cache here.
